title: Remulla: Impostor poses as Sandiganbayan justice to track witness in Romualdez plunder case
summary: An individual allegedly posed as a Sandiganbayan justice to locate a key witness in the plunder case against Leyte Rep. Martin Romualdez, Ombudsman Jesus Crispin Remulla said on Saturday.
